historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission upheld the negative declaration for demolishing the existing structure and building nine live/work units.
The City Planning Commission approved constructing nine live/work units at the site.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the project to remove a vacant industrial storage shed and build nine live/work units.
